Name: Tilled Soil Decay Options
Author: CaptainSully
Description:
Two simple options to determine how tilled soil will decay:[list]
[*][b]Days to decay[/b] - How many days your tilled soil is safe from day after being watered.
[*][b]Decay chance [/b]- The chance (0 to 1) that tilled soil will decay overnight, if 'Days to decay' has been reached.
[/list]For reference, the vanilla decay chance is 0.1 (aka 10%), with days to decay being 0.

That's it!

This [b]WILL [/b]work across season changes. Going into a new season is treated like any other day. This is the primary reason I created this mod, as existing ones don't work on season changes.

Only works on Farm maps, and the Ginger Island farm.
